instructions: In this description, what does the measurement "{candidate}" give?

criteria.length: length or edge length of the piece (the longest side, or the side of a cube)
criteria.height: height or depth of the piece, how deep a hole or foundation goes
criteria.wall: wall thickness of a hollow piece such as a planter, pot, bowl or seat cube
criteria.thickness: thickness of a slab, plate, table top or floor
criteria.count: number of identical pieces, posts or holes
criteria.other: anything else: bag weight, distance, grain size, strength, price
